children.name: (Senior) Branch Manager, Channel Management
children.ans:
Job Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all branch staff to achieve preset business goals and targets
  • Plan and manage business strategies and activities to meet business targets
  • Oversee daily branch operations
  • Ensure high quality of services are provided to customers
  • Ensure all activities are in compliance with the Bank’s policies and procedures and regulatory requirements

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor degree or above, with major in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing or related disciplines
  • Minimum 5- 8 years of solid branch management experience
  • Good knowledge and strong sense on compliance and banking regulations
  • Qualifications of IIQAS and HKSI
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical and leadership skills
  • Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese, including Mandarin

To Apply
Please submit your resume to hrd@icbcasia.com.

children.name: Senior Personal Banking Manager
children.ans:
Job Responsibilities

  • Introduce and demonstrate retail banking products and services to customers (especially mortgage related business for Mortgage Sales Manager)
  • Promote deposit, mortgage loan, insurance, investment and other retail banking products/services
  • Achieve business goals through proactive business solicitation and relationship building with customers
  • Address customer needs by providing quality customer service and financial advice to customers
  • Comply with established policies and regulatory requirements
  • Assist in promotional activities of branch banking products and services

Job Requirments

  • University degree with minimum 3 years of relevant experience
  • Qualified insurance and securities intermediary
  • Working knowledge of retail banking products and services and the related branch operations and procedures
  • Good relationship building and selling skills
  • Good command of written and spoken Chinese and English with knowledge of Putonghua
  • Candidate with less experience will also be considered

To Apply
Please submit your resume to hrd@icbcasia.com.

children.name: Senior Mortgage Sales Manager
children.ans:
Job Responsibilities

  • Achieve assigned mortgage business target and explore new business network
  • Prepare periodical reports to the management on matters relating to mortgage loan business development
  • Handle mortgage applications and follow up the process until loan disbursement
  • Maintain and develop relationship with existing and new client base

Job Requirements

  • University graduate with major in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing or related disciplines
  • Minimum 3 years working experience with bank mortgage products or property agencies, with financial institution exposure preferred
  • Strong sales and service orientation
  • Able to work under pressure
  • Good command of spoken and written English, Chinese and Putonghua

To Apply
Please submit your resume to hrd@icbcasia.com.

children.name: Branch Service Manager
children.ans:
Job Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily operations of branch
  • Ensure all operations are carried out in a proper manner and full compliance with the Bank’s policies and procedures and regulatory requirements
  • Ensure high quality of service is accurately and efficiently provided to customer

Job Requirements

  • HKCEE holder with passes in Chinese, English and Mathematics
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in branch operations, of which at least 3 years at supervisory level
  • Familiar with general consumer banking products and services, banking practices, relevant banking ordinances and regulatory requirements
  • Qualifications of IIQAS and HKSI
  • Good communication, interpersonal and supervisory skills
  • Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese including Putonghua
  • Candidate with less experience will be considered for the position of Counter Service Manager/ Officer

To Apply
Please submit your resume to hrd@icbcasia.com.

children.name: Senior Counter Service Manager
children.ans:
Job Responsibilities

  • Perform a variety of customer transactions over the counter
  • Provide high quality service to customers
  • Promote bank products to customers over the counter

Job Requirements

  • Secondary education or above
  • Minimum 1 year bank teller or counter service experience for Counter Service Officer
  • Pleasant and customer-oriented
  • Good command of Chinese and English
  • Candidates will less experience will be also considered

To Apply
Please submit your resume to hrd@icbcasia.com.

children.name: Customer Due Diligence Officer, Channel Management Department
children.ans:
Job Responsibilities

  • Conduct PEP and sanction checks on existing and new customers as part of the due diligence process
  • Follow up with customers for latest KYC/CDD related information and ensure its accurateness
  • Coordinate and work with internal stakeholders on KYC/CDD process to ensure its compliance with regulatory requirements
  • Compliance with Anti Money Laundering and Counter Terrorist Financing Regulations (AML/CTF)
  • Participate in banking activities and ad hoc projects/duties as assigned

  • Job Requirements
  • University graduate
  • Minimum 1 year working experience
  • Knowledge of branch and/or KYC/CDD related operations
  • Knowledge of the Bank’s regulations and policies; general banking practices, audit and compliance requirements, etc
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Good command of written and spoken Chinese and English with knowledge of Putonghua

To Apply
Please submit your resume to hrd@icbcasia.com.
